messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My worst birthday was last year, my 18th.

output.original_text: My worst birthday was last year, my 18th.
output.joy: My birthday last year, my 18th, was a lesson in resilience but also a spark of motivation!
output.sadness: My birthday last year, my 18th, was the worst I’ve ever experienced; it left me feeling so lonely.
output.fear: My birthday last year, my 18th, was terrifying; I felt so lost and uncertain about everything.
output.anger: Last year, my 18th birthday was the worst; I can't believe how everything went wrong!
output.surprise: Can you believe my 18th birthday last year turned out to be my worst one yet?
output.disgust: Last year’s birthday, my 18th, was just revolting; I can't believe how disappointing it was.
